items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: Joe Martini did a dead long time ago. And Joe used to take all my numbers down.

ctx.x: Well, how did you get your tunes written down?

Well, I had a fellow, I mentioned it on there just now. Joe Martini did a dead long time ago. And Joe used to take all my numbers down. And the strangest thing about it, when he took this triangle jazz blues down, it would, I notice here it says.
